evidence.evidence_text: Improvements in language models’ capabilities have pushed their applications towards longer contexts, making long-context evaluation and development an active research area.

However, many disparate use-cases are grouped together under the umbrella term of “long-context”, defined simply by the total length of the model’s input, including - for example - Needle-in-a-Haystack tasks, book summarization, and information aggregation.
